# Refiner

Refiner is a customer feedback and survey tool designed to help businesses collect and analyze user insights.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/refiner/.

## Actions

- **Delete Contact**: Delete a specific contact by its identifier.
- **Get Account Info**: Fetch refiner account subscription and environment usage details.
- **Get Contact**: Retrieve details of a specific contact by its id.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts from your refiner account.
- **Get Forms**: Retrieve a list of forms (surveys) from your refiner account with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Get Reporting** (read-only): Retrieve aggregated reporting data for surveys including metrics and analytics.
- **Get Segments**: Retrieve a list of user segments from your refiner account.
- **Get Survey Responses** (read-only): Retrieve all survey responses from your refiner account with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Track Event**: Record a user event by name for a user identified via user id or email.
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact's attributes or account.
